Eye Pattern - Monochrome Eyes.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Monochrome Eyes
A single flat color fills both the iris and sclera — no distinction between iris and white, creating a solid-color eye.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Monochrome Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both eyes are a single flat monochrome color across the entire visible surface — iris, pupil, and sclera blend into one unified tone with no contrast between them. Apply monochrome flat eye finish using selected eye color. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
